Not ready for a fresh fixed-range Reviewer at exact clean HEAD `67bb450ddd8809af5437c565ca75743888ccda77`.

One controlling Plan-002 contract remains violated: a credential-shaped accepted tool call identity is sanitized in the stored Receipt, but the artifact still claims `acceptedReceipt`. In `src/recorder/extract.ts`, `artifactKind` is computed only by comparing accepted `details`; the outer `toolCallId` is not included. `src/recorder/run.ts` then scans/redacts that call id while persisting `receipt.json`, yet preserves `artifactKind: "acceptedReceipt"` and records only `redactionStatus: "redacted"`. A direct current-HEAD production-seam probe returned `{"extractionArtifactKind":"acceptedReceipt","storedRedacted":true,"storedArtifactKind":"acceptedReceipt","storedToolCallId":"[REDACTED]"}`. This contradicts Plan-002’s explicit law that any scanned change to an accepted Receipt must be labeled `sanitizedDerivativeOfAcceptedReceipt` and must not claim accepted-byte equality.

Repair the existing extraction/storage seam so mutation of any stored Receipt member—including bound call identity—classifies the artifact as `sanitizedDerivativeOfAcceptedReceipt`, preserves the sanitized Receipt/audit identity join, and produces coherent manifest `artifactKind` and `redactionStatus`. Extend the existing Judge/Reviewer credential lifecycle regression to assert those semantics in `receipt.json` and `manifest.json`; do not add a scanner, hook, or parallel Receipt builder.
